plan.notes: Source: official Transfer Articulation Agreement 'Sinclair College AS Biology to University of Cincinnati BS Biology' (hosted at uc.edu), signed July 2023, valid June 2023 to July 2026; no explicit catalog year printed — catalog_year set from the agreement dates and noted honestly. Only the Sinclair-side courses (Semesters 1-4) are transcribed; UC-side semesters and the optional 'Recommended Courses' (Organic Chemistry, Language Requirement) are not part of this plan. SUGGESTED SEQUENCE per pipeline rules (the map calls it 'the following suggested course sequence'). Credit sums verified: 15+14+16+16 = 61, matching the map's declared 'Total credits for AS Degree: 61'. CHE 1251, CHE 1261, and BIO 2236 are official 0-credit co-requisite labs, transcribed with required_zero:true (excluded from sums, not dropped). The newer OGTP combined map for the same program (revised July 2025, 'Total credits for AS OGTP: 65-66') was NOT used: its row sums (64 at BIO 2225 = 4 per the Sinclair catalog) do not reconcile with its declared total and it omits the SCC 1101 First Year Experience that this agreement requires — recorded in blocked-log.md instead of transcribed. No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence is empty.
